description: This is an HTML source file that constructs a web-based database viewer interface, including styling and client-side JavaScript code for fetching database, table, and data information from a backend API.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend and populates the sidebar with options.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables and initiates loading tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for the selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table from the data fetched from the backend.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data if truncated.
